ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from creating a Case with Type 'Account Service' and Sub-Type 'Create Account' if the related customer is blacklisted. Displays an error message on save.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Account Service'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Account')), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, 'Create Account'), Account.Blacklisted__c = TRUE, $User.LastName <> "Integration", ISPICKVAL( Account.Region_Flag__c , 'Bahrain') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Creating new account for blacklisted customer is not allowed.
